description_en: Obtain service statistics under hotline monitoring. Supports grouped queries by instance, time dimension, agent, department, and skill group
description_zh: 获取热线监控下服务统计量。支持实例、时间纬度、坐席、部门、技能组分组查询
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-hotline-service-statistics --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --start-date 1615083365000 --end-date 1617761765000 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --agent-ids 111 --dep-ids 100 --group-ids 123 --time-latitude-type minute --exist-agent-grouping true --exist-department-grouping true --exist-skill-group-grouping true --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHotlineServiceStatistics

parameters.description_en:
